content: <thought>Based on the mass (≈224 Da) and the 13C NMR (one carbonyl ~197 ppm, many aromatic carbons, and aliphatic carbons around 36 ppm), the data fit a symmetric 1,3‑diphenyl‑1,3‑propanedione (dibenzoylmethane). Its molecular formula is C15H12O2 (exact mass 224.083 Da), matching the observed m/z 224.12. The SMILES for this structure is O=C(Cc1ccccc1)C(=O)c1ccccc1.
